title: The $42 Billion Bank Run: How SVB Collapsed in 72 Hours
description:
Silicon Valley Bank collapsed in just 72 hours, burning through $209 billion in assets. We analyze the hubris, the missed risk warnings, and the digital bank run that brought down a banking giant.

From lobbying against regulations to the final FDIC seizure, learn how $42 billion was pulled in a single day.
